summary: This document defines a new Mobile IPv4 extension that lets a Foreign Agent report status information to a mobile node. Previously, a foreign agent adding such information could break the mobile node's ability to verify the home agent's authentication data. The new extension gives the status information its own place in the message. It updates RFC 3344.

eli5.summary: Imagine a friend passing your letter along and scribbling a note on it, which ruins the seal. This gives the friend a separate card for notes, so the seal stays unbroken.
